newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Harmony details bid for Grootvlei.
newsitem.headline: Harmony details bid for Grootvlei.

text.p: Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd and Grootvlei Proprietary Mines Ltd on Friday published a scheme of arrangement detailing terms of Harmony's bid for its Randgold stablemate Grootvlei.
In terms of the scheme Harmony will issue some 3.10 million shares in exchange for the cancellation of all the issued Grootvlei shares other than those held by Harmony.
Grootvlei shareholders registered, most likely, on June 6 will receive 30 Harmony shares for every 100 Grootvlei shares held.
When the scheme becomes operative, Grootvlei will become a wholly-owned subsidary of Harmony. Grootvlei's listings on the Johannesburg and London Stock Exchanges will be terminated.
Harmony in February announced it planned to bid for Grootvlei, and Grootvlei's neighbour Consolidated Modderfontein Mines Ltd.
